name: Dream Bodies
description: Six sculptural families recreated in Godot from Palle's Stable Diffusion panoramas (2026-08-29, 'any chance you can recreate some of these bodies in godot?'): glazed Rocaille figurines with patterned skins, De Stijl slab robots, panelled robots, a Frank Stella wall tangle, pastel ceramic dragons, and a chorus of patterned beasts. One artifact, one axis: figure picks the family, seed picks the individual. Every builder works from primitives and SurfaceTool alone, with its patterns painted into textures in code, so a body is a recipe and not a mesh on disk.
theoreticalGrounding: The diffusion model dreamed these bodies from prompts that name painters, styles and desires in one breath; the museum answers by rebuilding them as procedures - a body as a seed and a rule rather than a picture. What survives the translation (a lean, a pattern, a palette) and what does not (the glaze, the dream's confusion of limbs) is the argument: compression keeps the queer remainder or it does not.

dream_bodies.name: Dream Bodies
dream_bodies.description: A statue from one of six families, chosen by figure and grown from a seed: rocaille (glazed entwined figurines with wave-stripe and scale-lattice skins), stijl_robot (Rietveld slab robot in white, saffron, pink and red with a domed helmet), panel_robot (armour-panelled robot in one saturated colour with chrome joints), stella_wall (a 2.4 m wall relief of layered flat cut-outs in mauve, teal and mustard), dragon (a rearing pastel ceramic dragon with scales and translucent wings), sea_forms (an upright patterned beast with zebra, giraffe, wave or bead skin and tentacle limbs), coral_polyp (a standing reef body under dense pebble scales, branching coral fronds growing from its back), tube_reef (a woven column of thick tubes in white, lemon and magenta with a spotted eel rising through it), david_drape (a neoclassical figure inside heavy swinging robes), dubuffet (a standing body hacked out of chalky blocks), garet_still (a glossy figurine with a fishnet or wave skin over a still life of fruit and leaves), kruger_suit (a hooded body in a suit printed with letters, stripes or a maze, beside a flat cut-out), oni_dragon (a kabuki dragon-demon with scale skin, fin crests and fangs), lava_bloom (a black twisted bough smothered in flat blossoms).

dna.predicted_degeneracy: stijl_robot vs panel_robot, ~9%: both upright humanoids of about the same height and stance; they differ in slab-versus-panel skin and palette, which is a large share of frame but not the silhouette. stella_wall is the far value from everything: a 2.4 m relief where the others are 1.5 m statues.
dna.note: fourteen figures by 2026-08-29 evening, from three batches of panoramas. coral_polyp and tube_reef joined from two more panoramas of the same sea-life prompt. seed is not an axis: it is the individual. The builders live in commons/artifacts/dream_bodies/bodies/<figure>.gd, one file each, static build(root, seed) and describe().
